items.title: India Hosts 12th Labour and Employment Ministers' Meeting in Hyderabad
items.whyInNews: The 12th Labour and Employment Ministers' Meeting was held in Hyderabad, attended by Union Minister of Labour and Employment, Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya, and other dignitaries.
items.summary: The meeting aimed to discuss labour-related issues and promote employment opportunities. Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya emphasized the importance of 'seva' and 'samman' towards the nation's workforce. The meeting also focused on strengthening labour laws and promoting social security for workers.

items.title: India and Maldives Successfully Conclude First Round of Free Trade Agreement Talks
items.whyInNews: India and Maldives successfully concluded the first round of talks for a Free Trade Agreement (FTA) in New Delhi.

The talks were held between the Indian and Maldivian delegations, led by senior officials from the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. The agreement is expected to increase trade volumes and promote investment between the two nations.

items.title: India to Track Every Indian at Sea, Liaison Officers for Each Affected Family
items.whyInNews: The government has decided to track every Indian at sea and appoint liaison officers for each affected family, following the death of nine Indian seafarers.
items.summary: The decision aims to ensure the safety and well-being of Indian seafarers and provide support to their families. The government has directed the Shipping Ministry to implement the measure, which will involve tracking the movement of Indian ships and crew members. The liaison officers will provide assistance to the families of seafarers in case of emergencies.

items.title: Spain Reaches FIFA World Cup Final

items.title: Norway Firm to Set Up River Kinetic Energy Demo Plant in Arunachal
